build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run build && cargo run -q --manifest-path ../../../Cargo.toml -p agenium-cli -- --root ../resources models download

bundle.shortDescription: AI agent teams that work through tickets
bundle.longDescription: Agenium runs a team of AI coding agents through tickets: a Lead turns your request into a spec, a plan and tickets; workers build each ticket in its own git worktree inside a sandbox; nothing reaches main without a review and a merge.
